webhooks.detail: Webhooks only as an action inside automation rules (ticket create/update), not a REST subscription API; Growth/Pro/Enterprise plans. Marketplace apps can also register external-event webhooks.

evidence.quote: Webhooks can be triggered via the automation rules that run on ticket creation

sandbox.detail: No free dev sandbox or dev account documented in pages read. Only a time-limited trial (50 calls/min API limit). Freshdesk sandbox appears to be a paid-plan feature but not confirmed.

evidence.quote: For every trial period the API limit is 50 per minute.

rate_limits.summary: Per-minute, per account, by plan: Growth 100, Pro 400, Enterprise 700; trial 50; lower per-endpoint caps (e.g. ticket create 50 on Growth)

evidence.quote: The number of API calls you can make is based on your plan.
For all trial users, there is a default API limit of 50 calls/minute.
